0022600111.text: The Warriors (0-2, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Phoenix Suns (0-1) in Golden State's third game of the season, with Golden State 13th in the West and Phoenix 15th. Golden State is without Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, and Stephen Curry, while Charles Bassey and Draymond Green are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams and Oso Ighodaro, and Luke Kennard is day-to-day and a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet this season, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 101-97 win in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
